data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error while auditing .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive file verdict and cascading to an inconclusive package verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited both files and correctly identified them as safe. There is no actual security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The orchestration layer should implement retries or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400/500) instead of immediately failing the file audit and cascading to an inconclusive package verdict.
Distinguish between tool/infrastructure failures and actual security inconclusiveness when determining the final package verdict.
